services.name: Cabin 1
services.desc: Our cabins are very popular for family vacations and those attending Military graduations at Fort Leonard Wood, MO. Our Cabins are well maintained with heat and air, equipped with TV, refrigerator, microwave, coffee pot, shower and flush toilet. Please note that pillows, pillowcases and bed sheets provided for the master bedroom only, no blankets or maid service provided. Our cabins are available 1 May through 30 October. Each cabin is just a short distance from the beautiful Gasconade River and your next great outdoor adventure. A minimum two-night consecutive stay required. A minimum three-night consecutive stay required on holiday weekends. Our cabins are very popular, so reserve early!
